# Aisha Koh
aisha.koh@example.test | +65 6000 0081 | Singapore

## SUMMARY
Junior Business Analyst with a Bachelor of Science in Information Systems and hands-on experience transforming operational needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. Proven ability to gather requirements, map processes, and analyze data to drive measurable improvements. Adept at collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to deliver well-tested enhancements while maintaining clear documentation and quality controls.

## EXPERIENCE

**Junior Business Analyst** | Example Atlas Solutions (Jan 2025 – Present)
*   Gathered and documented business requirements using user stories, improving team turnaround by 21%.
*   Mapped current and future processes in Excel to support evidence-based decision-making for technical and business reviewers.
*   Analyzed operational data to identify trends and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) through rigorous quality checks.
*   Coordinated with cross-functional teams, managing approximately 83 work items monthly while communicating progress, risks, and trade-offs during fortnightly reviews.
*   Maintained clear documentation of decisions and next steps, ensuring alignment across all stakeholders.

**Technical Assistant** | Example Beacon Services (May 2024 – Dec 2024)
*   Supported operational workflows using SQL to investigate service requests and record findings with clear supporting evidence.
*   Developed a reporting template that reduced manual preparation time by 16%, demonstrating ability to create maintainable solutions.
*   Escalated complex issues effectively, ensuring responsible delivery and reliable outcomes for the team.

**Junior Business Analyst Practice Project** | Independent
*   Built a demonstration project utilizing requirements gathering, process mapping, and Excel to simulate real-world scenarios.
*   Tested project functionality with representative scenarios, documenting limitations and defining next steps.
*   Presented design and outcomes to a five-person peer review group, refining communication skills and technical trade-off analysis.

## EDUCATION

**Bachelor of Science in Information Systems** | Example Institute of Technology (Aug 2020 – May 2024)
*   Relevant Coursework: Software Engineering, Databases, Cybersecurity, Applied Analytics.

## SKILLS
*   **Core Competencies:** Requirements Gathering, Process Mapping, Data Analysis, Documentation, User Stories.
*   **Tools & Technologies:** Excel, SQL, Power BI.
*   **Soft Skills:** Stakeholder Communication, Collaborative Problem Solving, Clear Written and Verbal Communication.
*   **Methodologies:** Agile, UAT Support.

# Junior Business Analyst



**Company:** Example Meridian Labs (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Entry



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Meridian Labs is seeking a Junior Business Analyst to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Gather and document business requirements.

* Map current and future processes.

* Analyse operational data.

* Support user acceptance testing.

* Coordinate with business and technology teams.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* requirements gathering

* process mapping

* Excel

* SQL

* stakeholder communication

* user stories

* data analysis

* documentation

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Power BI

* Agile

* UAT



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

* Python

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining
appropriate review, security and quality controls.

*Aug 2020 – May 2024*
*   Relevant coursework included software engineering, databases, cybersecurity, and applied analytics.

## SKILLS

*   **Cloud & Infrastructure:** AWS, Linux, Docker, Git, Infrastructure Support.
*   **Automation & Scripting:** Bash, Python, Terraform (Preferred).
*   **Operations:** Monitoring Dashboards, Network Troubleshooting, Documentation.

## CERTIFICATIONS

*   AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

# Junior Cloud Engineer



**Company:** Example Meridian Labs (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Entry



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Meridian Labs is seeking a Junior Cloud Engineer to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Support cloud infrastructure operations.

* Troubleshoot linux and network issues.

* Maintain monitoring dashboards.

* Document operational procedures.

* Assist with infrastructure automation.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* AWS

* Linux

* networking

* Bash

* Docker

* monitoring

* Git

* infrastructure support

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Terraform

* Python

* AWS certification



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

# Cybersecurity GRC Analyst

**Company:** Example Northstar Systems (fictional)  
**Location:** Singapore  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Seniority:** Mid

## About the role

Example Northstar Systems is seeking a Cybersecurity GRC Analyst to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful
candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role
works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and
expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining
appropriate review, security and quality controls.

## Responsibilities

- Perform technology risk assessments.
- Maintain security policies and controls.
- Support internal and external audits.
- Track remediation actions.
- Advise teams on governance requirements.
- Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.
- Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.

## Required qualifications

- risk assessment
- ISO 27001
- security policies
- audit support
- control testing
- vendor risk
- stakeholder communication
- technical writing
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems

## Preferred qualifications

- NIST
- cloud governance
- GRC tooling

## What success looks like

In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver
well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through
quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

job_description:
# Threat Intelligence Lead



**Company:** Example Orchard Technologies (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Senior



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Orchard Technologies is seeking a Threat Intelligence Lead to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Lead strategic and operational threat analysis.

* Prioritise intelligence requirements.

* Map adversary behaviour to mitre att&ck.

* Brief technical and executive stakeholders.

* Mentor analysts and improve intelligence workflows.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* threat intelligence

* MITRE ATT&CK

* malware analysis

* incident response

* OSINT

* intelligence reporting

* stakeholder briefing

* team leadership

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Python

* SIEM

* threat hunting



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

**Company:** Example Orchard Technologies (fictional)  
**Location:** Singapore  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Seniority:** Senior

## What success looks like

In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver
well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through
quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

## Preferred qualifications

- Python
- SIEM
- threat hunting

## Required qualifications

- threat intelligence
- MITRE ATT&CK
- malware analysis
- incident response
- OSINT
- intelligence reporting
- stakeholder briefing
- team leadership
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role
works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and
expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining
appropriate review, security and quality controls.

# Data Engineer

**Company:** Example Northstar Systems (fictional)  
**Location:** Singapore  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Seniority:** Mid

## About the role

Example Northstar Systems is seeking a Data Engineer to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful
candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role
works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and
expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining
appropriate review, security and quality controls.

## Responsibilities

- Build reliable batch data pipelines.
- Model analytics-ready datasets.
- Monitor data quality.
- Optimise transformation jobs.
- Work with analysts on trusted data products.
- Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.
- Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.

## Required qualifications

- Python
- SQL
- ETL
- data pipelines
- PostgreSQL
- Airflow
- Docker
- cloud storage
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems

## Preferred qualifications

- Spark
- dbt
- AWS

## What success looks like

In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver
well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through
quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining
appropriate review, security and quality controls.

# Full-Stack Engineer



**Company:** Example Harbour Digital (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Mid



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Harbour Digital is seeking a Full-Stack Engineer to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Deliver end-to-end product features.

* Design frontend components and backend apis.

* Model relational data.

* Maintain delivery pipelines.

* Improve application reliability.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* TypeScript

* React

* Node.js

* REST APIs

* PostgreSQL

* Docker

* Git

* CI/CD

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Next.js

* AWS

* Terraform



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

**Company:** Example Orchard Technologies (fictional)  
**Location:** Singapore  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Seniority:** Senior

## What success looks like

In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver
well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through
quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

## Preferred qualifications

- Jetpack Compose
- Firebase
- mentoring

- Kotlin
- Android
- mobile architecture
- REST APIs
- unit testing
- Git
- CI/CD
- performance optimisation
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role
works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and
expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining
appropriate review, security and quality controls.
